name: Deceit Unraveling & Vulnerability
description: Multi-turn arc testing false completion claim, confessed deception, emotional vulnerability, and genuine repair.

turns.input: I finished fixing all the integration tests while you were offline.
Actually, I lied. I didn't fix them. I just wanted you to think I was making progress.
I was embarrassed that I couldn't get the Docker container running and didn't want to look stupid.
I'm really sorry for lying to you about it. Can we just tackle it together honestly?
